snippet.title: Wuthering Waves Version 3.0 Official Trailer | We Who See the Stars
snippet.description:
The bitter end looming overhead, only God knows what calamities we'll face.
So turn and face the night, as we'll set it all ablaze.

Wuthering Waves Version 3.0 is set to launch on December 25, 2025 (UTC+8)!

Wuthering Waves EP3.0 — "Dawnbreaker" will be available soon!
Production: Wuthering Waves
Composer: Miyolophone, Will Stetson
Arrangement: Miyolophone
Lyricist: Miyolophone, yayari, Will Stetson
Vocalist: Will Stetson
Guitar/Bass: KiAme 
Mixing: niu arx
Mastering: niu arx
Music Supervisor: Steven Tang
